units: <cite ref="Shabbat 16a:4">Sabb. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>עבדי בהו רבנן ה׳</he> the Rabbis made a distinction (a somewhat different law) concerning glass ware.
<cite ref="Yoma 2a:6">Yoma 2ᵃ</cite> <he>כי היכי דליהוי להו ה׳</he> in order that they be distinguishable (from other sacrifices).

<cite ref="Horayot 13b:11-13">Hor. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>לא בעי … ה׳ וכ׳</he> ought there not to be a distinction (in honors) between myself and them? <cite ref="Pesachim 114b:2">Pes. 114ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ לתינוקות</he> some distinction to attract the attention of the children.—Pl. <he>הֶיכֵּרֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Zevachim 21b:11">Zeb. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>בי תרי ה׳ הוו עבדי</he> two signals were given at a time.
